# Astronomical v0.2.104
### Improved - On a first run, the "Draw a poster of a rocket launch" idea now offers the image model download when no image model is installed. Before, it ended in a failed drawing. - The download screens and Observatory's Models page now show the same size for the same model. - The welcome now introduces Astro, the assistant the chat window names. - The Help menu opens the website at its new address, getastronomical.com. - The website moved to getastronomical.com. Earlier addresses redirect, and updates keep arriving as before. - The README is focused on getting started, and the documentation was reviewed against the app and rewritten in plain language. - A new field note on the website measures one model fully in memory and under 16 GB and 12 GB memory ceilings. - Developer builds: quantization sensitivity probes reuse the reference forward's layer inputs, and an interrupted conversion can resume.
### Compatibility - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. - Your settings, downloaded models, conversations and prompt cache are kept. - The app and its disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
